For other uses, see René.

René is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. She is a Demonlord of Nogreth and a member of Chilling Beauties.

sections.title: In Brave Frontier I
sections.content: As part of the Battles of Brave Frontier 2 series, René can be fought in Chilling Beauties.
